source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer; OCR corrected against the page images. The paper prints "Final Examination - 2017-2018"; examYear 2018 is the later year of that session. Time : 2 hrs. + 15 min. (135 minutes), F. M. : 80. Sections A (20), B (18), C (20) and D (no total printed; 22 by the printed question marks). Question numbers restart in each section and are prefixed with the section letter here. Section A Q1/Q2 print (10) for ten items (1 each). Many items need figures (Section B Q2, Section D Q3–Q5 and the unnumbered circle fill-in-the-blanks), which are not reproduced. Exponents, square roots and simple interest have no matching class-6 chapter and are chapter null. Handwritten figure labels are part of the printed figures. The icseboard.org watermark is ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
